calloutText: Progressive hinting - Gunakan urutan: pertanyaan pemodelan -> arah complexity -> observasi kunci -> pseudocode parsial -> editorial. Solusi penuh adalah opsi terakhir. Semua soal yang membutuhkan editorial wajib dire-solve tanpa bantuan pada interval berikutnya.
resolvePolicy: Any problem that reached the terminal editorial hint level must be re-solved without help at the next interval, per the §5.3 mandatory re-solve rule. This records the obligation only; re-solve scheduling is out of scope for this module (see issue #14).
